data.title: Ready Capital Announces One-for-Ten Reverse Stock Split
data.description:
Ready Capital ( (RC) ) has shared an update.

Ready Capital, a multi-strategy real estate finance company, announced on November 23, 2026, that its Board of Directors had approved a one-for-ten reverse stock split without stockholder approval. Scheduled to take effect at 5:00 p.m. Eastern Time on December 7, the split will reduce approximately 159.1 million outstanding common shares to approximately 15.9 million and authorized shares from 500 million to 50 million.

The reverse split will apply uniformly and will not affect stockholders’ ownership percentages, apart from de minimis changes from cash payments for fractional shares. Conversion and change-of-control provisions for the Series C and Series E preferred stock will be adjusted proportionately, while their outstanding share counts, liquidation preferences and dividend rates will remain unchanged.

data.title: Lumentum Holdings Reports Results of 2026 Annual Stockholders Meeting
data.description:
An announcement from Lumentum Holdings ( (LITE) ) is now available.

On November 18, 2026, the company held its 2026 Annual Meeting of Stockholders, where 74,261,337 of 93,459,271 shares entitled to vote were represented, equal to 79.46% of outstanding shares. Stockholders voted on eight director nominees and an advisory proposal on named executive officer compensation, which received 60,726,089 votes for, 4,434,102 against and 583,079 abstentions.

The meeting also included a proposal to ratify Deloitte & Touche LLP as the company’s independent registered public accounting firm for the fiscal year ending July 3, 2027. That proposal received 73,303,895 votes for, 419,377 against and 538,065 abstentions.

data.title: GMEX Robotics Announces 1-for-19 Share Consolidation
data.description:
GMEX ROBOTICS ( (GMEX) ) has provided an update.

GMEX Robotics, formerly Fitell Corporation, operates at the intersection of consumer health and advanced automation. Its business is expanding from fitness-equipment e-commerce toward AI-driven robotic solutions designed around consumer needs.

On November 23, 2026, the company announced a 1-for-19 consolidation of all issued and unissued Class A, B and C ordinary shares, effective November 27, 2026; Class A shares were expected to begin post-consolidation Nasdaq trading under GMEX with a new CUSIP. The board approved the action on October 23 without shareholder approval; warrants and other equity rights will be adjusted proportionately, fractional shares will be rounded up, and broker-held shares will update automatically.

data.title: Route1 Announces Fort Collins ALPR Selection, New Orders and Patent Sale
data.description:
Route1 Inc ( (TSE:ROI) ) has issued an announcement.

Route1 announced that Fort Collins selected it through a competitive RFP to provide fixed ALPR systems at three city-managed parking garages. The selection remains subject to approval by the City’s Technology Review Board and contract negotiations.

Two Ohio law-enforcement agencies placed orders with Route1 to expand fixed ALPR networks, including cameras, integration, licensing and one year of support. Albuquerque also ordered five mobile ALPR cameras for parking-enforcement vehicles, adding to its 700-camera fixed public-safety program.

Route1 said the sale of seven U.S. patents from its former MobiKEY cybersecurity business generated approximately $273,000 in net cash proceeds. The company said it is no longer active in MobiKEY and will use the proceeds to support customer deployments in parking management and public safety.

data.title: Oncoinvent Grants Employee Share Options
data.description:
An update from Oncoinvent ASA ( (BRRGF) ) is now available.

Oncoinvent granted 231,758 share options to employees at a strike price of NOK 69,82 per option, representing 3.4% of fully diluted share capital. After the grant, employees hold 608,962 outstanding options, equal to 9.0% of fully diluted share capital and within the 10% limit approved at the May 2026 Annual General Meeting.

The options do not vest during the first 12 months, followed by monthly vesting provided holders remain employed, and lapse after seven years if unexercised. Of the total grant, 126,000 options went to primary insiders; the Board considers the program important for attracting and retaining employees and in line with market practice among comparable companies.

data.title: Yocale.ai Engages Investor Cubed for Canadian Investor Relations
data.description:
Yocale AI Inc Class A ( (TSE:YAI) ) has provided an update.

Yocale.ai Inc. has engaged Investor Cubed Inc. to provide investor relations and shareholder communications services in Canada. The 12-month agreement provides for $10,000 in monthly compensation and 400,000 options priced at $0.85 each, vesting in four equal quarterly tranches over 12 months under the company’s stock option plan.

Investor Cubed provides investor relations, financial consulting, dealer introductions, research, going-public assistance and access to capital for small- and mid-cap private and public companies. The engagement expands Yocale.ai’s external investor communications arrangements in Canada.

data.title: Kalyon Güneş Discloses Share Buyback Update
data.description:
Kalyon Gunes Teknolojileri Uretim Anonim Sirketi ( (TR:KLYPV) ) has issued an announcement.

Kalyon Güneş Teknolojileri Üretim A.Ş. disclosed an update on its share buyback program, initiated under a board resolution dated 19 October 2026 for up to 5,000,000 nominal shares and a maximum payment of TRY 300 million. The company said the program is intended to support healthy and stable share-price formation, protect shareholders’ interests and ensure the price reflects operational performance.

On 23 November 2026, the company repurchased 75,000 Class B KLYPV shares on Borsa İstanbul at an average price of TRY 48.702, within a range of TRY 48.12 to TRY 49.60. Following buybacks under the 9 December 2025 resolution, the nominal value of company-held shares reached TRY 5,133,133, representing 1.116% of share capital.
